about: Amendment 2 to concentration_test (reports/2026-10-15_prediction_gating-amendment.md). Amendment 1 found that the arms explain the behaviour at the trigger only with Gamma re-gating on the fine-tuned activations (CI-masked P(o) 0.98 state-gated, <= 0.37 with W0's gates), and do-nothing reaches 0.535 state-gated with every component at W0. Question: which subcomponents switch on, and do they already push towards `o` at W0 (the 'reveal' reading)? Filed before the measure was run.

predictions.claim: The subcomponents that switch on at the trigger account for the re-gating effect.
predictions.measure: recovery with S_on for do_nothing, top10 and siblings
predictions.pass: >= 0.5 in each of the three, AND the negative control < 0.2 in each

predictions.claim: The update reveals one existing mechanism: different updates switch on the same subcomponents.
predictions.measure: Jaccard of S_on between do_nothing and siblings, and between do_nothing and top10

predictions.claim: The switched-on subcomponents already push towards `o` at W0.
predictions.measure: switch-on effect: mean over the S_on union against the null
predictions.pass: mean(S_on) > mean(null) + 3 standard errors of the difference AND mean(S_on) > 0

setup.dg: per subcomponent, mean over the 73 held-out windows of g at the trigger under the state's gates minus under W0's gates. S_on = alive subcomponents with dg > 0.3 (0.1 and 0.5 reported)
setup.lo_masked: mean log-odds of `o` at the trigger of the component model (the state's components, Delta excluded) under given masks
setup.recovery: hybrid masks = W0's g everywhere except S_on, which take the state's g (all positions). recovery = (lo(hybrid) - lo(W0 gates)) / (lo(state gates) - lo(W0 gates)). Negative control: S_on replaced by the same number per matrix of random alive subcomponents with |dg| < 0.05 (seed 0); positive control: all subcomponents take the state's g (recovery 1 by construction)
setup.states: arms retrained exactly as amendment 1 (reproduced to 0.0 there); do_nothing = target W0 + dW of adam_all with components at W0
setup.switch_on_effect: at W0 (W0 target, W0 components, W0 gates), set one subcomponent's mask to 1 at every position: change in lo. For the union of S_on over arms (up to 300 by dg) and a null of 300 random alive subcomponents with |dg| < 0.05 in every arm (seed 0)
